title: GTA 6 Release Date in India: Price, Editions, PC Window
description: GTA 6 release date in India is November 19, 2026, per paidfreedroid.com. Here is the reported price, editions, pre-order options and PC window.

body.text: The GTA 6 release date in India is November 19, 2026, according to paidfreedroid.com, matching the global launch on current-generation consoles. The report says pre-orders are open in India, with the Standard Edition priced at ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition at ₹7,499. For Indian players, that means the price, the platform and the PC wait are now the questions that matter.
GTA 6 release date in India and what it costs

Paidfreedroid.com says Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive are selling two tiers in India. The base edition is ₹5,999, which the publication describes as a conversion of the $69.99 standard price.
The Ultimate Edition at ₹7,499 is aimed at collectors. Per the report, it includes exclusive digital items and Vice City Online bonus assets.
Where to pre-order GTA 6 in India

Digital buyers can pre-order on the PlayStation Store India or the Microsoft Xbox Store, according to the source. Pre-loading lets you download the core files early so the game unlocks at midnight on launch day.

Physical copies reportedly come with a commemorative Vice City collector map. Paidfreedroid.com also warns that stock of the Ultimate Edition SteelBook variants is limited at Indian distributors. It advises buyers to check courier dispatch schedules if they want the game on release day.
Console requirements and the PS5 Pro upgrade
The game is built only for current-generation hardware, so PlayStation 4 and Xbox One are out. The report says players need at least 212GB free on the main internal SSD.

On the PS5 Pro, Rockstar is said to use PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) along with ray-traced global illumination. Paidfreedroid.com claims this delivers stable 60FPS in dense Vice City districts. We could not independently confirm these performance claims, so treat them with caution until reviews arrive.
Why there is no PC version on day one
Rockstar has confirmed a console-only launch, according to the source. A Windows release is projected for between late 2027 and early 2028.

The report points to precedent. GTA V reached consoles in September 2013 and PC in April 2015, while Red Dead Redemption 2 reached PC a year after its console debut. Studio leadership has reportedly said staggering platforms lets the team tune physics and streaming for fixed console hardware before tackling the wide range of PC GPUs, drivers and anti-cheat setups.

Check the final price on your chosen store before paying, as the ₹5,999 and ₹7,499 figures come from a single publisher's report. Also watch SteelBook stock, courier dates and the 212GB storage requirement ahead of November 19. The report notes that Take-Two has targeted over $8 billion in net bookings and sees India as a fast-growing market for big-budget games. Any official PC date from Rockstar will be the next big update for PC players.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 release date in India?
faqs.a: According to paidfreedroid.com, GTA 6 launches in India on November 19, 2026, at the same time as the global rollout on current-generation consoles.

faqs.q: How much does GTA 6 cost in India?
faqs.a: Paidfreedroid.com reports the Standard Edition at ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition at ₹7,499. The Ultimate Edition adds exclusive digital items and Vice City Online bonus assets.

faqs.q: When will GTA 6 come to PC?
faqs.a: Paidfreedroid.com says Rockstar has confirmed a console-only debut, with a Windows PC release projected between late 2027 and early 2028.
